async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the Customers link to open the dropdown menu
    customers_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Customers')
    await customers_link.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Wait for menu to open
    # Now click the All Customers link in the menu
    all_customers_link = page.get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='All Customers')
    await all_customers_link.wait_for(state='visible')
    await all_customers_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for content to load
